typography._comment: Deliberate divergence, not drift — see CALL_STATE.md-style precedent of documenting *why* a value differs. The base semantic/typography.json scale was bumped for Android/Portal's 10-foot TV viewing distance (a real legibility audit finding: 14-17px body/caption text is phone-fine-print-sized when read from a couch). Web is read at arm's length (desktop/phone browser), where that floor doesn't apply — this override pins web back to its own already-tuned sizes rather than inheriting the TV bump. contactName needs no override: it was already large enough for both contexts. badge has no override anymore: it's pinned to 10px in the base scale itself now (explicit user request, overriding an earlier TV-legibility argument for keeping it larger there) — same value on both platforms already, nothing left to diverge. statusRow gets the same pin as caption (14px) — web's status checklist was already sized right at arm's length before Android's TV-driven statusRow role existed; only Android needed the reduction.
